import json
from pathlib import Path

import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
folder = Path('_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/evidence/story-5-11/owner-doc-follow-up').resolve()
for patch in sorted(folder.glob('*.patch')):
    repository = Path.cwd().parent/patch.stem
    revision = subprocess.check_output(['git', '-C', repository, 'rev-parse', 'origin/main']).decode().strip()
    scratch = Path(os.environ['TMPDIR'])/patch.stem
    scratch.mkdir()
    subprocess.run(['git', 'init', '--quiet', scratch], check=True)
    for line in patch.read_bytes().splitlines():
        if line.startswith(b'--- a/'):
            path = line.removeprefix(b'--- a/').decode()
            output = scratch/path
            output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            output.write_bytes(subprocess.check_output(['git', '-C', repository, 'show', f'{revision}:{path}']))
    subprocess.run(['git', '-C', scratch, '-c', 'core.whitespace=cr-at-eol', 'apply',
                    '--check', '--whitespace=error', patch], check=True)
    print(f'{patch.stem} {revision}: pass', flush=True)
